models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.note: Commercial use is fine. Attribution required.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.note: Commercial use is fine. Attribution required.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B

models.name: DeepSeek R1 14B
models.tagline: Thinks things through, out loud. Strong on tricky logic.

curation.note: Slower per answer (it reasons at length); pair with a fast specialist.

models.name: LLaVA 7B
models.tagline: Can read screenshots, charts, and photos of whiteboards.

curation.note: The vision specialist: attach a screenshot and ask what is on it.

models.name: Moondream 2
models.tagline: A tiny screenshot reader for machines with little room to spare.

curation.note: Not as sharp as LLaVA, but it fits almost anywhere.

models.name: Nomic Embed Text
models.tagline: Finds the right files. Powers repo search, tiny and always resident.

recommended.note: Turn this on and repo search starts finding code by meaning. Tiny and always resident.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B
models.tagline: Fast for small edits and instant answers.

curation.note: The latency helper: trivial renames and quick lookups without waking the big model.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 1.5B (pocket)

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.note: Commercial use is fine. Attribution required.

curation.note: The iPhone starter: quick, coherent, and fully private on the phone.

recommended.note: The iPhone starter. Quick, coherent, and fully private on the phone.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B (pocket)

curation.note: Smallest and fastest; pick Qwen 1.5B when you want sharper answers.

models.name: SmolLM2 1.7B (pocket)

curation.note: A friendly conversationalist; smaller context than Qwen.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 3B
models.tagline: A tiny coder that still writes usable edits. Good on very light machines.

curation.note: A middle step between the 1.5B helper and the 7B starter.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 7B
models.tagline: A strong general model for chat, reasoning, and clean writing.

curation.note: The general-purpose sibling of Qwen Coder. Pick Coder for code work.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 14B
models.tagline: More headroom for planning and analysis on a 16 GB machine.

curation.note: A capable all-rounder for reasoning-heavy, non-code tasks.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 32B
models.tagline: A big general brain for hard reasoning and mixed code and prose.

curation.note: Needs 24 GB of VRAM. A general counterpart to Qwen Coder 32B.

models.name: Mistral 7B Instruct
models.tagline: A fast, friendly all-rounder that writes well and follows instructions.

curation.note: A long-standing open favorite. Lighter on code than Qwen Coder.

models.name: Mistral Nemo 12B
models.tagline: A 12B all-rounder with a long context window for big documents.

curation.note: Reach for the long context when a task spans many files or pages.

models.name: Phi 4 14B
models.tagline: Microsoft's compact model that reasons and codes above its weight.

curation.note: Strong reasoning for its size. Shorter context than the Qwen line.

models.name: Phi 3.5 Mini
models.tagline: A small, quick model with a long context for its size.

curation.note: A light reasoner that fits small machines and long inputs.

models.name: Gemma 2 9B
models.tagline: Google's open model with a warm, articulate writing voice.

curation.note: A pleasant writer. Shorter context than Qwen or Mistral Nemo.

models.name: Gemma 2 2B
models.tagline: A tiny, tidy writer for quick drafts and short replies.

curation.note: Fits almost anywhere. Reach for a bigger model on hard tasks.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
models.tagline: Meta's small all-rounder with a long context window.

curation.note: A capable small model when you want Meta's lineage and long context.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill 7B
models.tagline: A small reasoner that thinks through tricky logic step by step.

curation.note: The lighter R1 for machines that cannot fit the 14B distill.

models.name: Yi Coder 9B
models.tagline: A dedicated coding model with a long context for large repos.

curation.note: An alternative coder to Qwen when you want a longer context.

models.name: Granite 3.1 8B
models.tagline: IBM's open, enterprise-minded model for code and reasoning.

curation.note: A clean Apache option with a long context for mixed work.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B
models.tagline: The R1 reasoner distilled onto a Llama base, strong on math.

curation.note: A Llama-based R1 distill. Pick the Qwen distill for a different lineage.
